newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Banco Industrial seeks foreign partner.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Banco Industrial seeks foreign partner.

text.p: Banco Industrial is planning an association with a foreign bank that would nearly double the Guadalajara-based bank's capital, bank president Juan Arturo Covarrubias said on Tuesday.

After six months of analysis, "We have seen the possibility of an association with four or five foreign banks, fundamentally Spanish," Covarrubias told Reuters in an interview. "I estimate that in the next 60 days we could have a response as to which bank it will be."
Covarrubias said the bank ended August with 130 million pesos in capital and that an association with another bank would bring in an additional 120 million pesos.
"The bank manages about 1.9 billion pesos in loans and we hope with this (capitalization) to double our loan portfolio and finance another two billion pesos," he said.
The potential partner would have a minority stake in the company, Covarrubias said.
